description: This file contains configuration functions and settings for Honda Accord and Prelude engine management, including sensor setup, output pin assignments, and engine type-specific configuration functions.

methods.name: void setHondaAccordConfigurationCommon(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Shared configuration setup for Honda Accord engine types, setting sensor types, ignition, injection modes, sensor channels, pin assignments, and other engine parameters.

methods.name: void setHondaAccordConfigurationThreeWires(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Configures the engine as Honda Accord with three-wire trigger, setting engine type and trigger type, then calling the common setup.

methods.name: void setHondaAccordConfigurationDip(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Configures the engine with DIP switch setup for Honda Accord, setting appropriate engine and trigger types, then calling the common setup.

methods.name: void setHondaAccordConfiguration1_24(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Sets engine type to 1-24 tooth trigger for Honda Accord and performs common setup.

methods.name: void setHondaAccordConfiguration1_24_shifted(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Sets engine type to shifted 1-24 trigger, adjusting trigger offset, then calling the common setup.

methods.name: void setHondaCivic4_0_both(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Configures a Civic with 4-tooth trigger, both rising edge detection and custom tooth count, then calls shifted 1-24 setup.

methods.name: void setHondaCivic4_0_rise(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Configures a Civic with 4-tooth trigger on rising edge only, then calls shifted 1-24 setup.
